subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should WebChat restart recovery be satisfied by the scoped transcript notice fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95154, or should this issue wait for a broader restart-deferral/request-preservation design?
rationale: Current source confirms the no-notice gap, but the issue's suggested directions include product-visible choices with different session-state and UX contracts.

options.title: Land the scoped notice fix
options.body: Accept a persistent WebChat delivery-mirror recovery notice as the immediate fix and track request-preservation or restart-deferral improvements separately.

options.title: Require broader recovery first
options.body: Keep the issue blocked until the implementation also prevents the user request from being lost or auto-recovers it safely.

options.title: Split the issue
options.body: Use the linked PR for the no-notice branch and file separate canonical follow-ups for restart deferral and immediate user-message persistence.

recommendation.title: Land the scoped notice fix
recommendation.body: Accept a persistent WebChat delivery-mirror recovery notice as the immediate fix and track request-preservation or restart-deferral improvements separately.

likelyOwner.reason: History shows adjacent restart-recovery merge decisions and delivery-mirror/storage work, making this the strongest available routing signal for the product contract choice.
